name: Ruin Pulse
desc: A burst that throws back everything close. Every Sworn has it.

name: Fenrir's Quake
desc: Slam the ground and launch everything within six metres.

name: Thor's Wrath
desc: Three waves of lightning that shock and chain.

name: Skadi's Breath
desc: Two waves of frost: the second freezes.

name: Surtr's Ring
desc: A ring of fire that sets the crowd burning.

name: Gungnir's Fan
desc: Seven piercing spears in a fan.

name: Yggdrasil's Grasp
desc: Roots everything nearby and mends 20% of your health.
